newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada hopes to seal Chile trade deal by Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Canada hopes to seal Chile trade deal by Thursday.

text.p: Canada is hoping to finalize a free trade agreement with Chile by Thursday so it can be signed during Chilean President Eduardo Frei's visit to Ottawa this weekend, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
"I hope that we are in a position to do something by Thursday," International Trade department spokesman Charles Larabie said.
"We hope that we have the agreement in a state to be signed by President frei when he comes this weekend," he added.
Larabie said a Canadian negoitiating team went to Santiago on Friday to work on the final details of the free trade deal. The team was expected back late Wednesday or Thursday.

The free trade agreement between the two countries would be outside the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), which groups Canada, the United States and Mexico. But it was seen as laying the groundwork for Chile to join NAFTA. -- Reuters Ottawa Bureau 613-235-6745
